subject: ACME renewal & expansion — post-call recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <j.lee@acme.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ACME renewal & expansion — post-call recap

Hi Jordan / Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment and clear next steps. I kept this intentionally short.

Summary of current state / pain points:
- Rising inference cost for your summarization pipelines (Q2 token spend +45% YoY).
- Occasional p95 latency spikes during end-of-day batch ingest windows impacting support SLA.
- Underutilized KV cache for RAG flows — leads to unnecessary token generation.

Goals we heard on the call:
1) Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% while maintaining quality for customer-facing summaries.
2) Bring p95 tail latency under 300ms for interactive support workflows.
3) Add a dedicated path for high-throughput nightly batch jobs to avoid impacting live traffic.
4) Align renewal + expansion timeline so procurement can budget for Sep 2026 renewal and Oct/Nov expansion.

Potential upsell / recommended path (high level):
- Move production chat/summarization to Dedicated (reserved capacity) for steady traffic and predictable unit economics.
- Keep experimental/low-volume models on Hosted to reduce ops overhead.
- Apply targeted quantization and prefix caching for the summarization workload; I’ll share quantization impact estimates in the pricing spreadsheet.

Action items (owners / target dates):
- Marissa: Share Q2 usage report + proposed pricing (attached) — today.
- Rishi (cc'd): Technical deep-dive on Dedicated sizing and latency options — schedule w/ Jordan by end of next week.
- Jordan / ACME: Confirm procurement timeline and any SOC 2 / audit evidence requests — please reply with expected procurement decision week.

Attachments: ACME_usage_report_Q2.pdf (usage breakdown) — sending now. I’ll follow up with the proposed pricing file + expanded plan.

Proposed next meeting: 60-minute technical + pricing review the week of Jul 20. Please share preferred time slots.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the call. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement is aiming to present a budget ask to Finance in the first week of Sep (so renewal timing you noted aligns well).
- Security: we will need SOC 2 evidence (audit logs + data retention policy) and a short note on network isolation options for Dedicated. Can Neha or Rishi share those artifacts in the next packet?
- RAG detail: our RAG workload accounts for ~40% of summary calls during peak hours — would prioritize any cache-first improvements.

We’re generally supportive of testing Dedicated, but we’d like a small pilot (reserved pool for the summarization workflow) before committing to a full cluster.

Jordan
Director of Product — ACME Corp
j.lee@acme.com | +1 646-555-0199

P.S. Sofia / Carlos — please weigh in on procurement timeline and pilot size when you have a minute.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: ACME renewal & expansion — post-call recap

Appreciate the quick reply, Jordan — and good notes. Confirming next steps and attaching the proposed pricing workbook (proposed_pricing_redwood_v2.xlsx) that outlines: pricing for Dedicated pilot, quantization/throughput scenarios, and estimated savings vs current hosted spend.

Rishi — can you take lead on the pilot sizing? Suggested pilot:
- Reserved pool: 2 x A100-equivalent slots (estimated based on current Q2 peak)
- Duration: 8 weeks (pilot), with SLA for p95 latency target of 300ms during pilot for the reserved pool
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in per-token cost for the summarization pipeline; p95 < 300ms during peak windows

Neha — can you attach the SOC 2 artifact pack and a brief note on network isolation options (VPC + private deployment checklist)? If not available today, a timeline for delivery works.

Proposed timeline:
- Jul 16–23: schedule tech deep-dive and procurement sync (Rishi + Neha + Jordan + ACME infra)
- Jul 24–Aug 7: pilot setup and baseline measurements
- Sep 6: procurement decision point / renewal sign-off
- Oct 2026: ramp expansion if pilot meets criteria

Would you be available for a 60-min technical review on Jul 22 at 10am PT or Jul 23 at 9am PT? I’ll coordinate a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — attaching proposed_pricing_redwood_v2.xlsx and CC’ing our tech lead. Let me know if you want a short pre-call with procurement only.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
